description: Edit an uploaded image with a JSON list of ops, always re-rendered from the original (no quality loss), with numbered versions to undo or branch (from=0 = original). Resize, crop, social presets (instagram_square, story, og_image, youtube_thumbnail, favicon...), rotate, adjust colors, blur, captions, watermarks, logo overlay, rounded/circle. Output jpeg/png/webp/avif/gif/ico, max_kb size target. Metadata stripped. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

format.description: jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif, or ico

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

from.description: Version to build on (default: latest; 0 = original). Use to undo or branch.

max_kb.description: Keep the output under this many KB

ops.description: JSON array of operations (an array, or the array as a JSON string)

name: image_edit
title: Non-destructive image editor
